issues.description: Planet near seventh cusp descriptively matching proposed partner can replace seventh lord; source flexibility cannot be treated as a prospectively specified classifier.
Moon is described as a partner significator without explicitly specifying how to weigh it against first/seventh lords.
Movable first lord AND Moon and reception absence require attention to the named dignity alternatives, not an arbitrary reception condition.
Reconciliation after movable-sign discord is qualified by continuing mistrust and weak benefit; not uncomplicated success.
Fixed-sign durability, absence-of-reception weak profits and commodities lying long are one conditional passage, not unrelated examples.
Common signs, movable signs and fixed signs retain Lilly contextual labels; do not collapse contrary meaning across different significator sets.
Malefics affecting BOTH first and seventh lords are distinguished from malefic placement in either first or seventh house.
Claims of dishonest querent/partner are only historic authorial character assertions with no authenticated real people.
Moon separating from benefic and applying to another benefic is claimed to bring beginning/end well but no wealth; retain simultaneous outcome qualifications.
The source prints and so the contrary, without an enumerated inverse decision table.
When the Moon separates from an ill planet and applies to another, the adjective for the second planet is not re-stated; do not insert an assumed malefic.
Symbol following ill planet in second on PDF412 looks like node-like glyph but exact identity/scope is not independently certified.
The circled-cross glyph after observe in PDF412 resembles Part of Fortune; distinguish visual symbol from confident symbol attribution until full witness collated.
Benefics casting sextile/trine toward the lords of first/seventh may be a joint or distributive condition; exact quantified AND grouping unresolved.
The seventh/eighth-lord square/opposition to the printed glyph clause spans PDF412→413 and implies common-stock loss, not an authenticated embezzlement.
LIII and LIV are not both canonically accepted as prerequisites, and copied page JPEGs are source witnesses rather than independently verified pixel identical full-PDF renders.
